description: This file is a Perl module ('getpart.pm') that provides functions for parsing and extracting parts of XML-like test data files related to the curl project, including methods for accessing XML sections and parts, decoding content, and file I/O operations.

methods.name: normalize_part
methods.description: Normalizes function arguments for caching by appending the XML filename.

methods.name: decode_hex
methods.description: Decodes a hex-encoded string, removing non-hex characters and converting to binary data.

methods.name: testcaseattr
methods.description: Extracts attributes from 'testcase' sections in the XML test data.

methods.name: getpartattr
methods.description: Retrieves attributes of a specified section or part within the XML test data, with caching.

methods.name: getpart
methods.description: Retrieves content from a specified section and part, handling base64 and hex decoding as needed.

methods.name: partexists
methods.description: Checks existence of a specified section or part in the XML test data.

methods.name: loadtest
methods.description: Loads XML test data from a file into memory.

methods.name: fulltest
methods.description: Returns the entire test data as a list of lines.

methods.name: savetest
methods.description: Writes current test data to a specified file.

methods.name: striparray
methods.description: Removes lines matching a pattern from an array.

methods.name: compareparts
methods.description: Compares two arrays of lines for equality, ignoring differences like line endings.

methods.name: writearray
methods.description: Writes an array of lines to a specified file.

methods.name: loadarray
methods.description: Loads a file into an array of lines.
